Thanks for the heads up. For vendor setup we need the following fields for Aurum Labs APAC Pte Ltd:
- Legal entity name
- Singapore UEN (or equivalent tax ID)
- Remittance address (billing contact + physical address for invoices)
- Billing email for electronic invoices (we can accept e-invoice pushes to billing@redwood.com or have the customer route via procurement)
